units.source_text: 古歌：“我命本无常，修短不可知。

en.t: An old poem says, "My life is by nature impermanent, and I cannot know whether it will be long or short.

units.source_text: 但愿在世时，忧患莫频催。”

en.t: I only hope that while I am still in this world, sorrows and troubles will not press upon me again and again."
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.
